settings.text: This wooden foldable table is a stylish, space-saving furniture piece designed for modern homes that need flexibility without compromising on appearance. The tabletop gives it a soft, elegant look, while the metal folding legs provide support, portability, and easy storage when the table is not in use. It works well as a dining table, tea table, side table, balcony table, or multipurpose living room table, especially in compact apartments and homes where saving floor space matters. The combination of wood finish and folding metal frame makes it practical for daily use while keeping a clean, modern aesthetic.

settings.heading: Product Features
settings.row_content:
• Space-Saving foldable design: The table folds down for compact storage, making it suitable for homes with limited space or for users who need a table only when required.
  • Tabletop style: The Tabletop shape creates a softer, more conversational seating layout and gives the table a balanced visual appearance.
  • Folding metal legs: The metal leg structure allows the table to open and fold easily while providing a sturdy base during use. Folding-leg tables are popular because they combine strength with practical storage convenience.
  • Modern wood finish: The wood-finish top gives the table a warm, natural look that works well with contemporary interiors. It creates a premium visual effect in online product images and home interiors alike.
  • Easy to move and store: Because the table is foldable, it can be shifted from one room to another and kept aside when not needed. This makes it a flexible option for everyday home use.
  • Multipurpose usage: This table can be used for dining, tea time, casual work, study, serving guests, and balcony lounging. Its design makes it useful across multiple rooms and use cases

settings.heading: Material
settings.row_content:
The table appears to use a wood-finish top paired with a metal folding leg frame. Similar products online often use MDF, engineered wood, or wood-finish surfaces with metal or powder-coated folding supports for stability and convenience. The visible construction suggests a balance of visual warmth from the tabletop and structural support from the metal base.

Top material: Wood-finish tabletop / wooden top style.

Frame / leg material: Metal folding legs.

Foldability: Yes, foldable for storage.

Design style: Space-saving, compact, modern, multipurpose.

Suitable spaces: Living room, dining area, balcony, terrace, study corner, and compact apartment rooms.

settings.heading: Care Instructions
settings.row_content:
• Wipe the tabletop with a soft dry or slightly damp cloth after use.
  • Avoid harsh cleaners, bleach, or abrasive scrubbers on the wood surface.
  • Keep the table away from prolonged water exposure to protect the finish.
  • Fold and store the table in a dry indoor space when not in use.
  • Dust the metal legs regularly to keep them clean and neat.
  • Avoid dragging the table on rough surfaces to reduce wear on the legs and floor.
  • Place the table on a flat surface for better stability during use.
  • Use coasters, mats, or placemats to protect the tabletop from heat, stains, and scratches.
  • Check the folding mechanism occasionally to ensure smooth movement and safe use.
